observations: Photo 0: Full-size electronic keyboard lying on green mat, white/black keys, 'YAMAHA Professional' logo visible top-left, control panel with sliders, 'MULTI MENU', 'AUTO BASS CHORD' labels.
Photo 1: Same keyboard from top angle, keys partly in shadow, Yamaha branding visible but model text too small to read clearly.

Photo 2: Close-up of control panel showing 'YAMAHA PortaSound' logo and partial model text, still not fully legible; buttons for rhythm, voice, and multi-menu visible; no power cable or adapter shown in any photo.
No photo shows the keyboard powered on, no sound indicator, no display screen lit, no adapter or stand included.
Seller's text calls the item a 'Yamaha keyboard' but also states 'The brand is Casio' — this directly contradicts the clearly visible Yamaha branding in all three photos.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the keyboard powered on or producing sound; 'quality' and 'good' condition cannot be confirmed from static photos.
Photos 0 and 2 clearly show 'YAMAHA' branding, not Casio; this is a direct mismatch between seller's text and the visual evidence.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have dead keys/speakers
risks.proof: A short video of the keyboard powered on, playing a note through its speaker

risks.risk: No power adapter included, which is often needed since these models rarely run on batteries alone
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter or battery compartment with batteries
risks.if_unproven: priced as excluding adapter, lowering value

risks.risk: Exact model unknown, so true specs (number of voices, rhythms, key size) can't be confirmed
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model number sticker (often on the back or near the logo)
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic basic/beginner Yamaha keyboard, not a higher-spec model

risks.risk: Mismatched brand claim in listing text raises doubt about seller's attention to detail or possible copy-paste from another ad, affecting trust in other claims
risks.proof: Seller re-confirming correct brand and providing a photo with the full model name in focus
risks.if_unproven: treated as an unverified listing, priced conservatively

proof_requests: A video of the keyboard powered on, demonstrating sound from the speakers
A clear photo of the model number/serial sticker, typically found near the logo or on the back panel
A photo of the power adapter or battery compartment
Clarification from the seller on the brand discrepancy (Yamaha vs Casio stated in text)
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Yamaha-branded beginner/children's keyboard, so it can be identified and priced by type despite the seller's contradictory Casio claim; since functionality is unverified, it is priced at worst case as a basic, unverified-working Yamaha keyboard comparable to the cheaper generic listings.
